title: Rav Anan bar Chiyya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Ketubot 21a](https://www.sefaria.org/Ketubot.21a.11) mentions a document issued by Mar Shmuel’s court, recording that Rav Anan bar Chiyya came and testified, with another witness—Rav Chanan bar Rabbah (or Rava). Hyman considers it very likely that he is the Anan bar Chiyya of Yevamot 115a (the corresponding account is at [Yevamot 116a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.116a.3-5)): a bill of divorce found in Sura read, “In the town of Sura, I, Anan bar Chiyya of Nehardea…” The Rabbis searched from Sura to Nehardea and found no other Anan bar Chiyya apart from Anan bar Chiyya of Hagra. Hyman argues that Abaye and Rava’s dispute about this does not mean that the incident occurred in their time; they disputed the ruling. In Hyman’s reconstruction, he is the Rav Anan bar Chiyya mentioned above.[^1]

notes.text: The Ketubot text names Rav Chanan bar Rabbah. The Yevamot discussion gives the testimony about Anan of Hagra and the arguments of Abaye and Rava. Hyman treats the court witness and the man named in the divorce document as likely the same person. Compare [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2906&lang=en) for the parallel accounts.
